## Verified Projects

### 1. Nexora — AI Meeting Intelligence Platform
- Status: In Progress
- Repository: https://github.com/realashuuu/nexora
- Stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Neon), Drizzle ORM, OpenAI API, tRPC, Redis, Stream Video SDK.
- Description: Automatically captures audio streams, generates structured transcriptions, extracts executive summaries, and synthesizes action items using OpenAI LLM pipelines with full tRPC type safety.

### 2. MivChat — Real-Time Messaging Platform
- Status: Live
- Repository: https://github.com/realashuuu/MivChat
- Live URL: https://miv-chat-vert.vercel.app/
- Stack: React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, Socket.IO, JWT, bcryptjs, Cloudinary.
- Description: High-concurrency bidirectional instant messaging featuring sub-50ms WebSocket delivery, live user presence status, Cloudinary image sharing, and seen/delivery tracking.

### 3. UnQue Lead PoC — Meta Lead Ads Event-Driven Integration
- Status: Completed Proof of Concept
- Repository: https://github.com/realashuuu/Unque-Lead-PoC
- Stack: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Mongoose, Socket.IO, React Native, Meta Graph API, Meta Webhooks.
- Description: Event-driven pipeline that listens for Meta Lead Ad webhooks, cryptographically verifies payloads, queries Meta Graph API, deduplicates in MongoDB, and streams real-time lead updates to a mobile dashboard in under 2 seconds.

### 4. Nexus Gaming Showcase
- Status: Live
- Repository: https://github.com/realashuuu/Landing-Gaming-Page
- Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Video, Responsive Grid.
- Description: High-performance cinematic landing page featuring background autoplay video, glassmorphism UI, and 60fps rendering without external framework overhead.

### 5. Enterprise Authentication Engine
- Status: Completed PoC
- Repository: https://github.com/realashuuu/Authentication
- Stack: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, bcryptjs, Nodemailer (Email OTP).
- Description: Production-grade auth microservice implementing dual-token rotation (short-lived access + rotating refresh tokens), secure HTTP-only cookies, and time-expiring email OTP verification.
